verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI natively supports bulk operations across many URLs: multi-URL configuration with per-pattern strategies, deep-crawl BFS with max-pages, parallel/high-performance crawling, and crash recovery/resume for long-running batch crawls. This is corroborated by CLI examples and GitHub docs, though independent hands-on benchmarking of large-scale batch runs is thin. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of bulk/batch performance at scale, and clearer first-party docs quantifying batch throughput limits.
